With QBP propagators W,W_R, K=e^{-beta v/2}W and K_R=e^{-beta v/2}W_R are contractions, ||K-K_R||<=eta_R, p_R=Tr(K_R rho_H K_R^dagger)>=exp(-beta w), and normalized output error<=min(2,2 eta_R/sqrt(p_R)). Both time signs are required. A finite-horizon generator-error certificate uses integral to T plus 2v q_beta(T); it does not incorrectly upper-bound the full L_R integral by this expression. The proof uses Duhamel, positive thermal kernel, variation of constants and purification stability. An exact rational three-spin Pauli argument at beta=1/2 gives ideal localization error<=11977/150000<0.080 for any finite exterior with the specified boundary; this is not a certificate for a numerical compiler or device.

Coherent patch-filter synthesis and one bounded output require expected O(exp(beta w)/epsilon^2) reference copies at constant confidence, counting failures, preparations, resets and measurements. No coherent reference preparation/reflections or free amplitude amplification are supplied. The product-Pauli ratio alternative instead costs O((L_A^2+L_Q^2)/(p_R^2 epsilon^2) log(1/alpha)); computing coefficient lists is charged. Generic patch storage is O(4^k), dense operations O(8^(k+r)) times actual quadrature/path/synthesis work, with precision and beta||h|| parameters. Instrument, statistical and reference-state errors are separate; the reference error term has inverse-acceptance dependence. The general certified compiler and large-patch implementation are absent.

A commuting two-qubit family has zero boundary leakage yet estimating the modified controlled-qubit expectation needs Omega(exp(beta w)/epsilon^2) copies, beta w>=log4 and 0<epsilon<=1/60. Unknown exterior alternatives are close in reference relative entropy but far after reweighting; the bound allows collective measurements. It matches overlap/statistical dependence, not preprocessing or gate cost, and is not a universal impossibility for structured materials. Filter success intervals also give free-energy intervals and a convex local moment-design objective; moment reachability and affordable gradient acquisition are not automatic and N711's global covariance claim is not imported.

For a differentiable path, R_s=dot H_s-i[A_s,H_s] yields transport generator iA_s-beta Phi(R_s)/2 and acceptance>=exp[-beta int osc(R_s)ds]. Established counterdiabatic ideas underlie the decomposition. Residual width is at least the spread of eigenvalue slopes; algebraically cancelling off-diagonal motion can require small-gap inverses and nonlocal controls. No affordable important extensive non-isospectral family was found. A deterministic local channel also leaves the exterior marginal unchanged. The surviving opportunity is an acquired observable-specific cancellation or update certificate, with full resources and independently audited proofs.
